note: quiz_page implements pages of questions as a Quiz question type: plugin QuizPageQuestion (#[QuizQuestion(id:'page')]) + quiz.question.type.page config entity (bundle of quiz_question). A 'page' is added to a quiz like a question; other questions are grouped onto it by setting the quiz_question_relationship parent field qqr_pid to the page's relationship. Pages do NOT affect the score (QuizPageResponse awards no points). Medium/hard cases are grounded in real 'page' quiz_question entities.

evals.prompt: How does the Quiz Pages (quiz_page) module implement grouping several questions onto one screen, and does a page affect the quiz score?
evals.expected_output: Pages are implemented as a question type: the 'page' plugin (QuizPageQuestion, #[QuizQuestion(id:'page')]) with quiz.question.type.page. A page is added to a quiz like a question, and other questions are attached to it via the quiz_question_relationship parent field qqr_pid so they render together. Pages do NOT affect the score.

evals.prompt: What question-type/plugin id does quiz_page register with Quiz, and which config entity must exist for it?
evals.expected_output: It registers the 'page' question plugin (QuizPageQuestion, #[QuizQuestion(id:'page')]) and installs the quiz.question.type.page config entity, a bundle of quiz_question.

evals.prompt: In Quiz, once I have a page, how are the other questions attached to it so they show on the same screen?
evals.expected_output: Each child question's quiz_question_relationship record gets its parent field qqr_pid set to the page question's relationship, grouping those questions under the page.

evals.prompt: This Quiz site has a page question titled 'quiz_pg_probe'. Inspect the live quiz_question entity and report the body/intro text configured on it.
evals.expected_output: quiz_pg_probe (type page) has body = 'Section A intro'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a Quiz page (a quiz_question of type page) titled exactly 'quiz_pg_task' that can be used to group questions onto one screen. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A quiz_question of type page titled quiz_pg_task exists (QuizQuestion::create(['type'=>'page','title'=>'quiz_pg_task'])->save()).
